text: You built something. And every month, people pay you for it.
Then somebody asks what it's worth, and you go quiet.
That silence is not a gap in you.
Nobody ever told you the honest part: nobody computes that number.
They estimate it, with rules of thumb.
There are six. And you can have all six, right now.
Churn under 3% a month.
Revenue that grows inside the customers you already have.
A customer worth three times what they cost to win.
That cost paid back inside twelve months.
80% gross margin.
And growth plus margin above forty.
Same revenue, six rules held instead of missed, and it is worth more than twice as much.
You were told to just go and get more users. You suspected that was lazy advice.
You were right. Nobody is counting your users. They are reading whether they stay.
So the fear of being found out, in a room full of spreadsheets, has it backwards.
It was never a test you fail. It is a map.
And you are the only one who has ever stood on the terrain.
Colombes puts all six in your hands. Move one, and watch your number move.
Your app is worth something today. Go and find out what.
Free. No sign-up.
